description: This Java class 'ZoneLoader' loads zone configuration data from a JSON file and returns it as a Map of zone identifiers to lists of 'ZoneTransient' objects.

classes.name: ZoneLoader
classes.description: Class responsible for loading zone configuration data from a JSON resource into a Java Map.
